perception_packet.product_object: A light, navigable knowledge landscape with an owner-private evidence and self-reported progression overlay.
perception_packet.user_job: Locate a sector, open a subject, inspect its sourced foundations and our actual work, then record or review an explicit personal position.
perception_packet.screen_state: Seeded Layer 1 catalogue with separately loaded, pending Layer 2 evidence; normal, linked, outline, review, source-consent, capture-receipt and recovery states.
perception_packet.eye_path: Atlas title and purpose → known landscape and selected sector → literal subject → sources and separate personal position. Drilled mobile states compact the title and provide subject jumps.
perception_packet.outcome_100ms: Design hypothesis, not a measured eye-tracking result: this is a calm, expansive knowledge workspace rather than a task/KPI dashboard.
perception_packet.outcome_1s: Design hypothesis: multiple named sectors and the focused branch are immediately distinguishable; emphasis denotes selection, not importance or mastery.
perception_packet.outcome_5s: Design hypothesis: the reader can choose a sector/subject and understand that source evidence, self-report and unassessed knowledge are different.

critical_dimensions.clarity: Literal sector/subject names and hierarchy are unambiguous; drill-down, breadcrumbs and return are visible without deciphering an unlabeled diagram.
critical_dimensions.expansive_composition: Several distinct areas coexist in the first working desktop view, with purposeful hierarchy and one knowledge object; no decorative network, scene or repetitive KPI-card foundation.
critical_dimensions.evidence_truth: Humanity's knowledge, source evidence and personal position are visibly separate; counts have scope, pending is not mastery, and unknown/outlines do not masquerade as verified coverage.
critical_dimensions.responsive_readability: Desktop and 390/320px views preserve legible hierarchy and controls; long labels/locators, sparse, partial, loading and error states remain understandable.

baseline.description: New Atlas surface within PTI. Existing Home warm-neutral/coral identity and clear app return informed compatibility; its room photograph/card grid was not copied.
baseline.none_reason: No previous Atlas implementation existed at the inspected baseline cee67b732634a7ccb12906d4c4c27e5b93377de4. Retained direction and cycle captures establish this new surface's progression.

comparisons.reference: Open Knowledge Maps actual working UI, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenKnowledgeMaps/Headstart/master/headstart.png
comparisons.matched_task_state: Broad topical overview alongside concrete detail.
comparisons.observed_gap: Useful overview/detail coexistence, but overlapping circles and tiny labels would obscure Atlas sectors; area may imply an undefined magnitude.
comparisons.disposition: Retain focus plus surrounding landscape; use literal sector names, real subjects and no size-as-knowledge claim.

comparisons.reference: Open Knowledge Maps future discovery concept, https://openknowledgemaps.org/img/future-of-discovery/1-start-page.png
comparisons.matched_task_state: Light overview of multiple disciplines with a search entry.
comparisons.observed_gap: Open simultaneous breadth is useful; anonymous circles and schematic placeholders do not provide clear actions. This is a concept, not a shipped-product claim.
comparisons.disposition: Retain the open field and simultaneous breadth; replace decorative circles with named actionable regions and selection-driven depth.

comparisons.reference: Our World in Data sourced chart, https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/co-emissions-per-capita.png?tab=chart
comparisons.matched_task_state: Content-first title, direct labels and inspectable provenance.
comparisons.observed_gap: Clear semantic hierarchy and source qualification are useful; a quantitative chart is not an appropriate form for unmeasured understanding.
comparisons.disposition: Use title, labels, references and uncertainty; do not borrow a quantitative chart or invented percentages.

visual_critic.reason: All17 final renders independently inspected, with image hashes recomputed. Literal sectors, semantic subtitles and focused subjects give clear scale; linked/pending/self-report/unknown states remain distinct; 320px recovery and expanded exact sources remain readable. This is a coherent editorial Atlas, not a9-level novelty or owner-approval claim.
generic_cues: Repeated card-grid risk: regular index justified by scanning; boxed oval cells and repeated desktop numeric metadata removed, expanded branch and context rail have distinct jobs.
Decorative futuristic metaphor risk resolved: no scene, orbit, invented centrality or unlabeled network; compact mobile drill/search headers prioritize the working object.
KPI/mastery dashboard risk resolved: counts are loaded evidence only; explicit map key, missing-data states, sourced outlines and caller-declared receipts prevent false completeness.

parent.reason: Personally inspected all17 final images. Twelve named sectors remain simultaneous with a real focused branch on desktop; literal subject and separated knowledge/personal-position columns guide drill-down. Mobile subject jumps, compact search recovery, exact source disclosures and truthful unavailable states are readable. Regular mobile rows and long review forms are acceptable scanning/permission tradeoffs, not evidence of maximal visual novelty.
generic_cues: Equal mobile sector rows remain directory-like, but the equal scanning affordance is meaningful and no fake spatial relationship is implied.
Review batches remain long editorial forms; consistent filters, source disclosure and subject jumps make them actionable rather than decorative dashboard cards.
Source approval forms remain utilitarian; exact bounded permission and clear enabled/paused status take precedence over decorative styling.

qa.reason: Final capture-manifest verifies17 exact state markers and image hashes with no overflow, broken images or page errors. Separate browser-qa.json records10 passing interactions,22 responsive checks, keyboard checks and0 computed text-contrast failures.83/83 Angular,58/58 MCP and9/9 hosted-helper tests passed; production/preview builds passed with existing soft warnings and no budget escalation. Live23/23 privacy/atomic-history probes passed before private bootstrap. Computed contrast is not full WCAG certification; synthetic interactions are not signed-in owner browser validation.
